newsitem.title: USA: Startronix agent says account frozen.
newsitem.headline: Startronix agent says account frozen.

text.p: Startronix International Inc's bank account has been frozen via a restraining order, and a group of investors has filed a lawsuit against the company claiming fraud, the company's placement agent said on Friday.

The placement agent said action was taken because when investors in Startronix's recent private placement submitted their preferred shares for conversion into common stock, the company refused without a valid and recognizable reason.
Startronix was not immediately available to comment.
A New York State Supreme Court justice signed a temporary restraining order freezing Startronix's bank accounts, the placement agent, which preferred not to be named, said.
The placement agent said it planned further aggressive legal action against the company.
